subject: Wondering if there's a compendium of add-on Shiny GUI widgets like shinyTree (for jsTree)

messages.author: a5edeb4fa89b826c
messages.subject: Wondering if there's a compendium of add-on Shiny GUI widgets like shinyTree (for jsTree)
parts:
So, I somehow managed to stumble across the shinyTree binding for jsTree (https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/shinyTree/index.html).  I almost feel lucky to have found it since the many Shiny-related searches (i.e. Google) I've done for Shiny widgets do not find shinyTree (could be operator error).  That got me wondering if there are other add-on Shiny widgets like shinyTree out there. I'm aware of the list of widgets at http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/ and I'd kind of imagined that to be the complete, master list of extensions of Shiny.  However, now that I've found shinyTree, I'm wondering if there is more out there.

So I'm wondering if anyone has any recommendations on how to find more Shiny extensions like shinyTree?   (Note that shinyTree is not part of the "Web Technologies and Services" task view on CRAN.)

Thanks in advance.
